title: Lighthouse Cutaway
summary: A raymarched WebGL2 architectural cutaway of a coastal lighthouse revealing its spiral staircase, living quarters, Fresnel lens, and ocean waves.
description: A single-file WebGL2 SDF cutaway showcase slicing open a stone coastal lighthouse on a rocky outcrop to reveal its spiral staircase, interior floors and furnishings, rotating lantern room lens, animated ocean swells, and multi-octave clouds. Drag to orbit, scroll to zoom, press 1–3 for weather presets (Clear Moonlight, Storm, Golden Dawn), Right Drag or L to adjust the sky light, and Space to pause.
